unmeasured_lexical_error_risk.candidate_behavior_from_source: A spaced macro lookalike inside a valid string triggers fallback lexing. A later unterminated string makes the lexer fail; the conservative error return disables the request cache.
unmeasured_lexical_error_risk.consequence: Potential repeated-invalid-source rejection latency regression; size not measured.
unmeasured_lexical_error_risk.required_followup_before_any_admission: Resolve or measure this case with explicit controls, including diagnostic ordering and chunked lexing with real external macros. A successful aggregate on other cases would not settle it.

preregistration.change: Only compiler/native/src/driver/cache.rs; V4 bounded lookahead and real native lexer. V3 was not compiled or timed.
preregistration.hypothesis: One conservative byte scan plus the native lexer only for trivia candidates corrects stale external input results and reduces source-scan work without new cache bypasses on valid lookalikes.

scenarios: long comment env variable exceeding256-byte lookahead budget
performance.analysis: paired ratio of process wall time, median and bootstrap95% interval; record all samples, failure/rejection outcomes, compiler hashes and CPU affinity
performance.limits: No universal speed claim. Reject admission if confidence does not establish actual-compiler improvement, or material native regressions remain. Never compare stale baseline output as equal correct work.
performance.admission: Paired geometric-mean runtime ratio below1 with bootstrap95% upper bound below1, all workload results and per-case regressions disclosed; no meaningful confirmed regression may be omitted.
performance.scenario_order: Rotate start by round; paired lane order alternates by even/odd round; 40pairs per14cases
performance.cache_detail: fresh empty perround/lane; request primed once; body/signature/invalid edits use fresh cache seeded with corresponding valid source perround/lane
performance.regression_rule: Report all per-case ratios; any case with bootstrap95% lowergeomean bound >1.05 is a confirmed material regression and blocks admission.
